title: Cat (YC S22) Seeks Fractional Engineer to Build AI-Native Growth Toolkit
originalTitle: Cat (YC S22) Seeks Fractional Engineer to Build AI-Native Growth Toolkit
content:
Seeking a self-starter for a fractional role.

Currently NOT accepting applicants from: CA, MA, NJ, OR, WA, CT, IL, RI, MD, MI, NH, HI.

Role is to support the team with organic growth engineering implementation and operations. This can range from designing AI tools for growth to hiring folks to do in-person canvassing off Craigslist! Growing the world's AI-native insurance broker still takes some IRL effort.

Anyone with a growth mindset and a willingness to overcome operational obstacles to ensure experiment success are encouraged to apply. Opportunities for additional incentive pay.

Please, only apply via the YCombinator Work-at-a-Startup application button above. Emailed applications will be discarded.
